The '''Geothermal Station''' was a geothermal [[Power plant/Legends|power plant]] located on [[Kessan's Landing]], an island on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. The geothermal station was [[Raid on Kessan's Landing|attacked]] by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] of the [[Hidden Chain]] during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR:THiO" />
